text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: metering.pipeline.high-lag fired for project: billing-ingest (P1). Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345

pd-bot: Incident created: INC-20260314-0043. Auto-assigned to oncall-ryan. Escalation policy: metering-sre.

oncall-ryan: ack. kicking off initial triage. I see the alert is for consumer lag on token-ingest-workers.

sre-ana: joining. current metric: consumer lag ~1.2M messages, consumer group stalled ~45m. checkpoint commit rate 0.1 msg/s.

oncall-ryan: any recent deploys?

eng-maya: nope, no deploys in the last 4 hours. We had a large prefix-backfill job started by dataops at 02:20 UTC. Might be related.

sre-ana: looks like backfill generated a surge. The consumer autoscaler didn't spin up because of a bug in scaling policy (min_replicas 0 when detector mis-evaluated).

oncall-ryan: root cause hypothesis: backfill + autoscaler regression -> consumer lag -> downstream reconciler skipping some token aggregates -> inflight dedupe logic hitting rate limit -> incorrect token counts queued.

billing-ops: flagged: if token counts under-report, invoices for some enterprise customers could be short by multiple percent. Which customers? any high-risk list?

eng-maya: running quick query on ledger-shards to estimate divergence. patching consumer config now. command to scale workers:

```
# temporary mitigation: scale replicas
kubectl scale deployment/token-ingest-workers --replicas=12 -n metering-prod
```

eng-maya: issuing scale now.

sre-ana: scaled to 12. consumer lag dropping from 1.2M -> 600k in 4m.

oncall-ryan: good. also pausing the backfill job to avoid new pressure. @dataops please confirm paused.

billing-ops: thanks. we need an immediate estimate of invoice exposure. eng-maya can you run a sample reconciliation for top 250 customers by spend and diff token counts?

eng-maya: running sample reconciliation. initial sample (top 50) shows ~0.8% lower token count on generated side vs ledger for 7 customers, variance concentrated on streaming endpoints. Might be ingestion dedupe path dropping duplicates incorrectly under heavy lag.

product-emma: potential customer impact: any customers on monthly billing cycle closing in next 72h? If yes, we might need to hold invoices.

billing-ops: yes — 43 customers hitting end-of-cycle within 72h, including 6 enterprise accounts with manual invoicing. Risk: incorrect totals leading to invoice disputes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty status change: acknowledged by oncall-ryan at 2026-03-14T09:14:47Z.

oncall-ryan: propose timeline: 1) short-term: scale workers + pause backfill (done) 2) mid-term: run full reconciliation job for last 24h window on high-value customers 3) long-term: fix autoscaler policy and add surge-mode throttling on backfills.

sre-ana: running reconciliation for top 250 now — estimated run 18m. I will post results.

eng-maya: note — while running, I found an edge-case in dedupe logic where kafka consumer reorder > window causes dedupe flag to be lost. adding instrumentation ticket: INF-5234.

billing-ops: interim request: place a temporary invoice hold for the 6 enterprise accounts. We'll do manual reconciliation before billing. Can legal/finance sign off?

product-emma: I approve hold for those 6 with immediate notice. We'll draft a short customer-facing note.

oncall-ryan: escalation: loop in finance lead if reconciliation shows >1% delta across >20 customers. @billing-ops please escalate if threshold hit.

sre-ana: reconciliation results: completed. Summary: of top 250 customers, 18 show >=0.5% delta, 4 show >=1.5% delta. Affected volume concentrated timeframe 02:10-03:05 UTC overlapping backfill.

billing-ops: confirmed manual hold placed for the 6 enterprise accounts. opening ticket FIN-1798 for audit trail.

eng-maya: mitigation steps: 1) force-reprocess windowed messages for 02:00-03:30 UTC with dedupe fixes in dry-run, 2) deploy autoscaler hotfix (patch branch: fix/autoscaler-min-replicas), 3) add alert: metering.backfill.surge and runbook update.

sre-ana: will deploy autoscaler hotfix to staging in 10m then can roll to prod.

oncall-ryan: action items assigned: eng-maya -> run reprocess dry-run and produce diff.csv for billing; sre-ana -> deploy autoscaler fix and monitor; billing-ops -> prepare invoice hold and customer comms; product-emma -> approve comms.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to billing-ops after ack (if unresolved after 30m).

eng-maya: reprocess dry-run done. attaching sample diff row: `customer_id=acme-inc, expected_tokens=1,234,567, reported_tokens=1,220,000, delta=-14,567, pct=-1.18%`

billing-ops: sample looks actionable. starting manual reconcile for the 43 end-of-cycle customers. ETA 3h.

product-emma: drafting customer note: "We detected an ingestion issue impacting some usage totals between 02:10–03:05 UTC. We have paused the backfill and are reconciling. If you are due to be invoiced in the next 72h, our billing team will hold invoices and reach out with reconciled totals."

billing-ops: copy. will send to legal for signoff.

sre-ana: monitoring update: consumer lag now down to 32k and decreasing. checkpoint commit rate recovering to normal.

oncall-ryan: thanks team. leaving this incident open until manual reconcile completes and holds are confirmed sent. Escalation: if discrepancies persist after reconcile, we'll convert to P0 and run a billing rollback plan.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-0043 status: monitoring. last update at 2026-03-14T09:23:30Z.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-20260314-0043 closed automatically by alert suppression at 2026-03-14T10:01:50Z (note: incident still tracked in Slack thread for billing actions).

oncall-ryan: final note — we should add a pre-flight check to backfill scheduler: if consumer_lag > 50k then block start. Filing runbook task: OPER-3123. :thumbsup:

billing-ops: will follow up with reconciliation completion and confirmation of invoice holds.

product-emma: will prepare postmortem draft once billing reconciliation done.

eng-maya: created fix PR for autoscaler and dedupe instrumentation ticket INF-5234.

sre-ana: closing out tech actions here, leaving billing actions open.

oncall-ryan: incident thread summary: cause = backfill surge + autoscaler regression; impact = undercounting tokens for subset of customers during surge window; mitigation = scaled workers, paused backfill, forced reprocess, placed invoice holds for critical customers; follow-ups = autoscaler fix, runbook update, postmortem and customer comms.

billing-ops: thanks. will update when manual reconcile completes (ETA ~3h).

pd-bot: Note: follow-up meetings scheduled: Billing Audit sync at 2026-03-14T13:00Z.

incident-bot: thread archived to incidents channel after last_message_ts 2109999010."
